These are some handy drag-and-drop compatible batchfiles.

To install, place the .bat files in the same folder as a copy of jFloaty.exe.

* jpg2png16.bat - decompress JPEG, dither to 16-bit per channel, and compress to PNG16.
* jpg2png8.bat - decompress JPEG, dither to 8-bit per channel, and compress to PNG.
* jpg2pfm32.bat - decompress JPEG and store to 32-bit per channelPortableFloatMap(PFM).

To use:
1. Drag and drop a JPEG from anywhere on your system on to jpg2png.bat
2. jpg2bpn.bat will configure jFloaty.exe to decompress the JPEG to an adjacent file like input.jpg.16.png.
